name: Bönningstedt (Germany)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bönningstedt (red figures and a blue wavy bend on white).
history: Municipal flag of Bönningstedt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bönningstedt arms — red figures and wavy bend on white
